insights.summary: Standalone Q2 FY27 revenue was ₹709 Cr (up 66% year on year, 27% on the quarter) with EBITDA of ₹114 Cr at 16.1% as utilisation rose. Unexecuted order book is ₹7,237 Cr (up 32%) and Q2 order inflow was ₹1,169 Cr, including a first nuclear order from NPCIL. Management kept FY27 guidance at 25%+ growth and about ₹3,200 Cr revenue, with the Changodar expansion starting around Diwali.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue growth 25% and beyond, about ₹3,200 Cr, PAT margin 9-10%
Changodar expansion now starts around Diwali (Q3), not Q2
CTC plant commissioning slips to Q3 with commercial output by Q4 (was Q2)
Working capital target improved to 110-120 days (was 120-130)
First nuclear order (NPCIL Kaiga 5 and 6); UK subsidiary set up in Sept 2026

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Following our Q2 performance, we remain confident of achieving FY27 guidance and continue to remain on track with our growth plans for the full year.

analyst_questions.answer: H2 needs about ₹1,930 Cr against ₹1,500 Cr last year; management said it is maintaining ₹3,200 Cr and has not raised it.
Prices are still high but most orders carry price-variation clauses, so margin is largely protected.
Working capital days to start falling from the end of FY27 as capacity and backward integration come in.
No price war; 'everybody has enough orders in hand'. Inquiries under negotiation are ₹21,000 Cr (80% domestic).

red_flags.text: Net working capital is about 154 days; receivables ₹1,053 Cr, of which ₹228 Cr is non-current.
Backward-integration plants (CTC, pressboard, bushing) keep slipping by a quarter or two.
Retention money of about ₹200 Cr is locked in receivables.
Q2 standalone EBITDA margin of 16.1% is well above the guided FY27 level, so margins may not be sustained if mix or raw-material costs turn.

watch_next: Q3 revenue near ₹900 Cr or more, as the ₹3,200 Cr target needs about ₹960 Cr a quarter in H2
Changodar and CTC plants starting on the revised dates
Order inflow of about ₹1,000 Cr or more a quarter

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Power, distribution and special transformers, reactors and EHV equipment, with backward integration into CTC, pressboard and bushings
business_snapshot.customers: State utilities (GETCO, APTRANSCO, DVC), PGCIL, NPCIL, EPC contractors, data-centre and industrial buyers in 40+ countries
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: About 55-60% of order book is 400 kV and above; export share targeted at 10-15%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Grid expansion, renewable integration, nuclear and data-centre power, replacement of ageing transformers
